problem: 89.5 s (35 % of the film) is one layout repeated 8×: same card position, same push, same 9–10 item right column (CASE tag, title, @handle, route chip, caveat, 炫在哪里, secret, 1–2 bullets, 可以照搬 box). That column is ~80–95 CJK chars per case; by G3 it needs ~18–21 s, but each scene lasts 10–12 s and the viewer is also watching footage and reading subtitles. The footage, which is why people clicked, gets 27 % of the frame (16:9 1000×562), 19 % (1:1 620×620) or 12 % (9:16 372×662). By case 4 the format is fully predictable; this is the only stretch that feels templated.
fix: (1) Open each case on the footage: from local 0 to (secret cue − 0.3 s), play the first clip at ≈1312×738 centred in the content box (y 141–879, letterbox 1:1/9:16), then shrink into the card over 0.5 s outCubic; the column starts after. (2) Text budget ≤ 4 blocks at once: merge '@handle · 路线 · caveat' into one 20-px fog line; drop the 炫在哪里/可以照搬 labels (lime secret and green box already mark them); show bullets one at a time (each replaces the previous) and dim them to 30 % when the takeaway lands. (3) Break the rhythm: mirror the layout on even cases (card cx 1288, column x 112), or give cases 05–08 a lilac accent. (4) Use the dead space: 1:1 card 620 → 700 px, 9:16 372×662 → 412×732.

scene: s06_c1 · s07_c2 · s08_c3 · s10_c5 (case.js → template owner)

fix:
Add one optional data-driven 'proof' graphic per case in the strip between the card bottom (y≈796) and the pager dots (y≈830), or replace the dots row.
- s07: 1000×14 px bar = 60 s with an amber #F2B880 segment at x 775–925 (the measured warm window 46.5–55.5 s, research/brief.md). A playhead follows the clip's source time (tree 19.9–24.3, then light 46.3–51.0), so it enters the amber exactly when the warm light plays.
- s08: three 8-px lanes 画面/旁白/配乐 with independent blocks and one shared playhead, labelled 「一条时间轴」.
- s06: four 20-px chips 按钮 → 播放器 → 图表 → 命令面板 that light as the morph reaches each state.
- s10: chips 首页 → 搜索 → 复制提示词 that light with clips c5-072-home/search/prompt.

scene: s07_c2 … s13_c8 (case.js template, route to template owner)
problem: The series-dot row, whose lime active dot is the storyboard's through-object in s06–s13, disappears at every case change. The outgoing page's dots slide out with the push. The incoming page's dots stay at opacity 0 until local 0.6 s and fade in over 0.5 s (case.js line 113: o = zoomIn ? 1 : prog(t, 0.6, 0.5)). So for about 0.5–0.7 s around each of the 7 pushes there is no dot row (for example nothing at 78.0–78.1, faint at 78.2).
fix: OUTSIDE (case.js line 113, template owner): use full dot opacity for 'push' as well as 'zoom', i.e. o = 1 whenever the transition is push or zoom. The incoming dot row, with its next dot active, then slides in with the page while the old row slides out, and the indicator never disappears.

scene: s08_c3 / s09_c4 (outside: narration.json lines + case data)
problem: The 照搬 line doesn't follow from the trick just shown, so a 小白 can't connect them. s08: 招 = 画面、旁白、配乐分层做 → 照搬 = 先写分镜，每场先出几张截图检查. s09: 招 = 用真实数据当约束 → 照搬 = 提示词只写意图和不想要的效果.

Align each takeaway with its trick, in both the voice line and the box:
- s08: 「照搬：画面、旁白、配乐分开做，对齐同一条时间轴」
- s09: 「照搬：找一份真实数据（地形、坐标、真实网页），让画面跟着数据走」 (brief.md §4 item 6)

The current lines fit naturally into s17/s19 if you want to keep them.

scene: s06–s13 (case template, case.js; route to template owner)
problem: The case right column is the densest text in the film (about 90 s on screen), but its reading text is under the design.md body size of 30–36 px. Points are 500 28px/1.4, the 可以照搬 takeaway is 600 28px, and the provenance caveat (作者自述 / 据作者 …, the honesty label the storyboard insists on) is 500 21px in fog, the faintest line in the column. On a phone the caveat is the first thing to become unreadable.

Everything still fits on one line: the widest point (「同一模型换一版风格，机身看起来一致」, 17 chars) is about 510 px + 24 px for the dot, under the 600 px column; the widest takeaway (15 chars) is 450 px; the widest caveat is about 410 px.
